strings.factory_error_apk_not_exists: The configured factory test apk does not exist, please check
strings.factory_error_tips: Factory test configuration file format error
strings.factory_error_tips_detail: The error may be around the %1$s line
strings.fulltime_off_shutdown_tips: To use voice control after shutdown, enable [Always-on Companion] in General settings.
strings.fulltime_on_shutdown_tips: After shutdown, the projector can still respond to voice commands, power-on requests, and screen casting.
strings.game_help_menu_tip: Long press the menu button to display the game menu
strings.game_helper_frontsignposition_tip: Direction key to adjust the crosshair position | Long press the menu key to restore default settings | Back key to exit
strings.low_battery_limit_open_bluetooth_speaker: Battery below 2%. Charge the projector before using Bluetooth speaker mode.
strings.shutdown_light_OS7_tips: Click the OK button to turn off the light source, click any button (except the volume button) again to turn on the light source.
strings.ultra_lowlatency_tip: Picture correction is unavailable and will be reset to its initial state.
strings.with_battery_bluetooth_speaker_tips: Bluetooth can be connected when the indicator light flashes, and it will automatically shut down if not connected after a timeout; short press the %1$s or %2$s key to exit the Bluetooth speaker mode.
strings.with_battery_deep_shutdown_tips: Power use is minimized. The remote cannot power on the projector; use the button on the projector.
strings.with_battery_shutdown_tips: Press the %1$s or %2$s button to set a scheduled shutdown; after shutting down, power consumption is minimized and can only be turned on through the body buttons.
strings.with_battery_sleep_tips: Press %1$s or %2$s to set a sleep timer. The remote can quickly wake the projector from sleep.
strings.with_battery_timing_shutdown_tips: An update is scheduled during shutdown. Charge the battery above 50%.
